summary.zh: 全球超大规模数据中心运营商。范围三十一个类别逐项披露、电力按四大区域披露、非会计年度（7 月–6 月）——是四份包里唯一能把范围三报表跑满的数据源。资本货物 FY25 同比 +44%，AI 扩张写在数字里。
summary.en: Global hyperscale datacenter operator. Eleven Scope 3 categories disclosed line by line, electricity split across four regions, and a non-calendar fiscal year (July-June) — the only pack here that can fill a Scope 3 report end to end. Capital goods jumped 44% in FY25; the AI buildout is visible in the numbers.

expected_reconciliation.why: Proxy grid factors drive this one. NA (20.9 TWh at US eGRID) is sound; Asia at a China factor and EMEA/LatAm at a US factor are stand-ins. Expect the computed total to run somewhat above the disclosed 12.03 MtCO2e. Replacing the three proxies with IEA country factors is the single highest-value fix to this pack.

Fuel-derived Scope 1 lands at 104,466 tCO2e against a disclosed 170,887 t (-38.9%). Microsoft's Scope 1 is 41% HFC refrigerant leakage (70,131 tCO2e in FY25), which no fuel table can produce. Refrigerants are the story here, not fuel.

notes: Non-calendar fiscal year on purpose: reporting_period runs 2024-07-01 to 2025-06-30. Good for shaking out any code that assumes periods start in January.
Scope 2 market-based jumped from 259,090 to 2,707,428 tCO2e in FY25 after Microsoft discontinued spot EACs in February 2025 — a real, explainable 10x that makes an excellent variance-narrative demo.
Electricity grew 24% (29.8 -> 37.0 TWh) while revenue grew 15%, so intensity rose from 122 to 131 MWh/$M. Both numerator and denominator are in disclosed_totals.
